description: Fetch one service quote thread with its deliverables. Buyer or seller side. Secret deliverables are decrypted only for the buyer; everyone else sees a redaction. Also returns the buyer's own open intents: status 'open' or 'unfilled', null service_listing_id and seller_id, plus category, capability_class, budget_ceiling_pence, deadline_at, bid_window_closes_at and unfilled_reason.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the quote thread to fetch.
